mapper.select: SELECT id, username, phone, password_hash, nickname, avatar_url, status, last_login_time, create_time, update_time FROM `user` WHERE username = #{login} OR phone = #{login} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO `user` (username, phone, password_hash, nickname, avatar_url, status) VALUES (#{username}, #{phone}, #{passwordHash}, #{nickname}, #{avatarUrl}, #{status})
